The selector's uncertainty explanation is kept verbatim. ONE-SHOT CLAIM: in EXECUTE mode only, right before dispatch (last authorization check), GO atomically creates (O_EXCL) a claim <git common dir of --repo>/odg-go-claims/<sha256(canon(record))[0..16]>-<item>.claim through the injected claims port — independent of --out; EEXIST ⇒ GO-ORD-2_ALREADY_CLAIMED (0 dispatch); the declared scratch already holding the item's experiment record ⇒ GO-ORD-2_SCRATCH_EXPERIMENT_PRESENT; no claims port ⇒ GO-ORD-2_NO_CLAIM_STORE. dispatchTimeout.rule: GO-DTO-1 (provider rule): plain odg-run dispatch ⇒ 600000 ms. A contract-declared scoped target ⇒ from WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT.preRegistration.caps: (a) caps absent, or neither maxRunWallMs nor perTrialWallMs declared ⇒ 600000; (b) maxRunWallMs declared ⇒ maxRunWallMs + margin; (c) else perTrialWallMs × trials + margin, trials = (|dataset.replication| + |dataset.heldOut|) × |keys(arms)| × |decoding.seeds| (an UPPER bound of the rows the runner may execute — every arm on every task at every seed); trials not derivable ⇒ the ceiling (conservative: a capped run is bounded by its own caps and is never killed early); (d) a declared wall cap (maxRunWallMs / perTrialWallMs) that is not a finite positive number ≤ Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (negative, string, NaN, null, 1e300 …) ⇒ dispatch REFUSED, code GO-DTO-1_MALFORMED_CAPS (fail-closed like GO-DT-1); a valid but huge result ⇒ clamped to the ceiling. Value = Math.ceil(result) (the exact integer odg-go.ts must use; any mismatch there ⇒ refused). Cycle deadline: when a declared target will be dispatched, effectiveDeadline = max(requested deadline, timeout + 300000) (the 300000 margin covers the steps before and after EXECUTE; elapsed-at-EXECUTE recorded) — extended, never refused, even over an explicit --deadline-ms (recorded): the dispatch is already bounded by its own timeout ≤ the ceiling, and a DEADLINE stop after it would only discard the EVIDENCE/NEXT_SELECTION of a run that already happened. results floored at 600000 (never below the plain timeout); margin 120000 ms; HARD CEILING 43200000 ms (12 h) never exceeded. Timeout kill semantics unchanged (SIGKILL ⇒ EXECUTED_FAIL; writes-confinement check still applied). The dispatch runs as its own process group (detached); timeout, STOP file, SIGTERM/SIGINT to GO or ODG_SCHEDULER_STOP=1 ⇒ SIGTERM to the group, 10 s grace, SIGKILL to the group, group exit awaited before the writes-confinement check
